description: Data-free example. Replace tag names, hashes, expected values, and factors with a reviewed map-specific sizing inventory. Factors shown here are examples, not defaults.

field_rules.reason: Example only: reviewed source sprite width is four times its chosen logical HUD width. Preserve bitmap pixels through placement scaling.

bitmap_resamples.reason: Example only: this fixed-size native draw path has no placement scale. Source sprite measurements justify this physical atlas normalization. Do not apply this factor to other HUD families automatically.
